changelog: FIX: Live TV, Movies, Series, and Guide now persist category, focused item, and scroll position so returning from player/detail restores where you left off.
FIX: Guide channel column and program grid vertical mapping now stays locked with explicit synchronized list-state mirroring, eliminating row drift after long scrolling.
NEW: Time-shift playback is implemented from Guide program selection (Watch From Start) when archive/catch-up is available.
FIX: PlayerViewModel now supports timeshift stream routing with Xtream archive URL generation.
FIX: Guide and Live TV now sync focused channel back from active player/zap state on resume.
IMPROVEMENT: Navigation restore behavior is now resilient across recomposition and process recreation using SavedStateHandle persistence.
